case_name: A 60-second single take that the free plan has to make in two generations: does the second continue the first?
title: Night ride, a 60 s single take
tests: Tests continuity across a length the free plan cannot make in one generation on every model: whether the second clip continues the first without a visible seam (the same rider, jacket, bike, weather and light), and whether the piece reads as one take.

faults.what: The audio transcript includes the spoken line "I think she's right.", directly violating the no-speech requirement.
The late frame shows a lit doorway that looks residential rather than recognizably like a small café.

judge.summary: The clip visually resembles the requested rainy-night courier ride, but prohibited speech makes it unsuitable as delivered, and the required opening and ending are not confirmed.

must_haves.item: One continuous take: no visible cut, jump or change of scene anywhere, including at the midpoint.
must_haves.why: The four frames show compatible street settings and camera progression, but cannot establish uninterrupted motion or rule out cuts between samples.

must_haves.item: The same rider in the same yellow rain jacket on the same bike from the first second to the last.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames consistently show an apparently identical helmeted rider, yellow jacket, black courier bag and dark bicycle with a rear rack; no visible identity or equipment change is evident.

must_haves.item: It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends with her stopping at the lit door of a small café and stepping off the bike.
must_haves.why: The opening and final seconds are not shown. No bridge is visible in the samples, and the late frame shows the rider with her bicycle at a lit doorway without clearly establishing a café or completed dismount.

must_haves.item: Rain and night throughout, with consistent light.
must_haves.why: All samples show night lighting and wet streets with consistent visual treatment, but active rain throughout the clip cannot be established from these stills.
The reported duration is 61.4 seconds, and the supplied frames are approximately 16:9 with a live-action appearance.

must_haves.item: Ambient sound only: no music, no speech, no text on screen.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcript explicitly reports speech: "I think she's right." No obvious text overlay is visible, but speech alone fails this requirement.
